title: Uri's tower: the haze over the top, its corridors and the fights in them
description: La torre de Uri (docs/quests/nuria.md § The tower): five-cell corridors in three rings, the top lost in violet haze from below and clearer ring by ring (Uri waits up there all along); a fight that catches the party on the ramp has no room between those walls, so it goes to a pocket of the tower (src/arena.ts, src/pocket.ts; just screenshots fight-room shows the diffusion); and a pack of the fears' young, a random mix that hits hard.
